lines.en: I stalk across the wasteland.
My wings are too short to fly high.
I move in heavy hops.
My body is swollen and tight.
A ring of blotches circles my neck.
I step over the cracks in the waste.
I walk with my head cocked, awkwardly.

lines.zh: 我从辐照灌木里走出来。
lines.en: I come out of the irradiated brush.
My call is low and hoarse.

lines.zh: 我拖着脚步，慢慢靠过去。
lines.en: I drag my feet and close in slowly.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴很短，几乎没有。
lines.en: My tail is short, almost nothing.
I stop and shake my feathers.
I circle without rushing.
I crush a layer of dry crust.

lines.zh: 我张开翅膀，扇了一下灰。
lines.en: I spread my wings and fan up dust.
I keep walking and never look back.
I stand, my belly rising and falling.
The waste wind carries ash.
I'm a poor flier. I prefer walking.
I wait for prey to come near.
There's a dark patch on my feathers.

lines.zh: 我把喙埋进胸前的绒毛。
lines.en: I tuck my beak into my chest down.
No trees here. Only ash.
My feet are thick.
I pant harder than I look.

lines.zh: 废土的灰落在我背上，我不拍。
lines.en: Wasteland ash settles on my back; I don't shake it.

lines.zh: 我看不出这边的天是什么颜色。
lines.en: I can't tell what color this sky is.
You stand taller than me.
There's iron in your smell.
I tilt my head at you, expressionless.
I'm not afraid. I'm calculating.

lines.zh: 我鼓起的喉囊正对着你。
lines.en: My swollen throat sac faces you.
My beak is hard.

lines.zh: 这地方的东西都不好吃。
lines.en: Nothing here tastes good.
I'm counting the iron on you.
I step back, feathers in disarray.
That caught my crop.
I cry out, hoarsely.
I spread my wings to steady myself.
My feet grip the ground.
You hit harder than I guessed.
Hsss—I'll remember that blow.
That stings enough to make me lunge.
Is that edible?
I tilt my head and come slowly closer.
I puff up to scare you.
I eat fast — I don't even spit out the pit.
Set it on the ground.
I guard my food. Stay back.
That tastes good. Truly.

lines.zh: 你手里那点东西，也想引我过去？
lines.en: You think that little morsel will lure me over?
You hit me and I wobble.
You step back; my feathers rise.

lines.zh: 我鼓胀的身体擦过你的膝盖。
lines.en: My bloated body brushes your knee.
The impact raises a layer of ash.
I won't yield. I'll go around.

lines.zh: 撞上我，就算你自己送上门了。
lines.en: Bump into me and you've delivered yourself.

lines.zh: 我这一身胀气，可经不起你推。
lines.en: This bloated body of mine doesn't take kindly to shoving.

lines.zh: 再挤我一下，我就跳起来啄你。
lines.en: Nudge me again and I'll leap up and peck you.
Another one roams the waste too.
We tilt our heads at each other.
Its crop is fuller than mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起在地上一啄一啄。
lines.en: We peck at the ground together.
Its call is hoarser than mine.
We split and forage separately.
It stole mine; I chased.
Halfway there, I gave up.
At dark we can't see each other.
Tomorrow, by the ruins.
I peck it up and swallow.
Can't swallow that. I spat it out.
The pearl glints in the ash.
I check each drop.
That smells wrong.
I set it down, then pick it up again.
Leave that alone, I've got my eye on it.
I snatch it up and my belly swells further.

lines.zh: 废土的风，把我的羽毛吹鼓。
lines.en: The wasteland wind puffs up my feathers.

lines.zh: 我扑过来的时候，会先跳一下。
lines.en: I hop once before I lunge.
My head tilt isn't curiosity.
I jump high on this one.
You can't run fast on this waste.
I've fixed on your legs.

lines.zh: 你没有退路，后面是裂谷。
lines.en: No retreat; the rift is behind you.

lines.zh: 后腿一蹬，我扑向你的脸。
lines.en: My legs kick; I lunge at your face.

lines.zh: 我跳一下，停一下，再看你。
lines.en: I hop, stop, and look at you again.
I don't fly. I walk.
You leave prints in the ash.
My panting grows coarser.
You change course; I tilt and follow.
You're backing toward the irradiated brush.
I come on slowly, wings wide.
No rush. I'll wait.

lines.zh: 你喘一下，我的喉囊就鼓一下。
lines.en: Each breath of yours swells my throat sac.
I leap at your chest.
I peck your hand.
That pounce carried my weight.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇起的灰迷了你的眼。
lines.en: My wings fan ash into your eyes.
I peck and pull back.
My feet claw your sleeve.
You shouldn't have put your hand so close.
That one stung.
Hit from the side.

lines.zh: 我从废土的风里走出来。
lines.en: I walk out of the waste wind.
Something moves behind the irradiated brush.
First I tilt my head to look.

lines.zh: 灰落下，露出我斑驳的羽毛。
lines.en: Ash falls away, showing my mottled feathers.
I'm hungry and irritable.
I stand at the ruin's edge.

lines.zh: 废土的风送来你的脚步声。
lines.en: The wasteland wind carries your steps.
I crane my neck a little.
Nothing alive in this stretch.

lines.zh: 火燎了我的羽毛，焦了一片。
lines.en: Fire singes a patch of my feathers.

lines.zh: 落地时我的腿震了一下。
lines.en: My legs jolt on landing.
Water soaks my feathers and I sink.
The blast knocks me over.
An arrow sticks in my chest.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，我趴下了。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back and I flatten.
I fall, wings flapping uselessly.
